name: youtube-transcript
description: Read-only YouTube caption fetcher, no API key: InnerTube backend (vendored library) plus a yt-dlp backend with the clean_vtt.py markdown cleaner; fetch, search, stats, batch
surface: read-only CLI; two read backends (InnerTube scrape, `yt-dlp --skip-download`); writes only a local file the operator names with `--out`, never over an existing one without `--force`; no YouTube write code exists

origin.note: local-only hello-* workshop, no public remote; the hello-* lib/ and examples/ are kept as-is. scripts/clean_vtt.py is a copy of ~/.claude/skills/yt-transcript/scripts/clean_vtt.py (the legacy skill this tool supersedes)

install.description: Install @danielxceron/youtube-transcript (the InnerTube backend) and dotenv locally from package-lock.json
install.why: yt.mjs imports the InnerTube library lazily; the examples import dotenv. Nothing is installed globally
install.yes: node_modules/ is created inside tools/youtube-transcript; no call to YouTube is made
install.no: skipped; fetch/search/stats/batch fail on import until you run it. The ytdlp verb and the unit tests work without it

auth.flow: No credential. Both backends read public caption tracks over the operator's own egress; YouTube rate-limits by source IP (HTTP 429), which is the only 'auth' that can fail

safeguards: Read-only by construction: yt.mjs holds no YouTube write code; the InnerTube backend issues GETs and the yt-dlp backend runs `yt-dlp --skip-download` (SENSIBILITIES #1)

Ceilings are code constants in yt.mjs, refused rather than lowered: MAX_BATCH=20 videos per call, MAX_CONTEXT=5, TIMEOUT_MS=30000 per call; `batch` sleeps BATCH_DELAY_MS=1500 between videos (SENSIBILITIES #3, #9)
--explain pre-flight (renderExplain) prints the video, backend, language, format and output path and makes no call (SENSIBILITIES #5)
Audit line to stderr before every network call (audit()): timestamp, verb, backend, video id (SENSIBILITIES #7)

Degraded mode is named: `fetch --format md` falls back to the yt-dlp backend when InnerTube reports no captions and says so on stderr; every other failure names the `ytdlp` verb to try (SENSIBILITIES #8)
The only file write is --out (emit()): an existing file is refused without --force; the yt-dlp backend works in a mkdtemp dir under the OS temp dir that is removed afterwards, never in the tree

Argument hygiene: extractVideoId() reduces every input to an 11-character id and the yt-dlp URL is rebuilt from it, so nothing the caller typed reaches yt-dlp's argv; --lang is validated against a language-code pattern; parseCli is strict and an unknown flag exits 2
No credential, no cache, no env: nothing to leak (SENSIBILITIES #11)

verbs.name: fetch
verbs.note: captions via InnerTube as text | timestamped | segments | json | srt | md; --out writes one local file; md falls back to yt-dlp when InnerTube has nothing

verbs.name: batch
verbs.note: stats per video, max 20, 1500 ms apart; exit 1 if any video failed

verbs.name: ytdlp
verbs.note: yt-dlp --skip-download --write-subs --write-auto-subs, then scripts/clean_vtt.py → markdown with a title/channel/date header; requires yt-dlp on PATH

verbs.name: any YouTube write (comment, like, upload, playlist)
verbs.note: no write code exists and no credential is held; the Data API is not used at all

risk.worst_case: YouTube rate-limits this IP (429) after a burst of fetches, capped at 20 videos per batch with a 1.5 s delay; or a transcript lands in a local file the operator named with --out

checks.fix: cd {TOOLBELT}/tools/youtube-transcript && npm install   (or: toolbelt setup youtube-transcript) — fetch/search/stats/batch need it; ytdlp and the tests do not

checks.label: python3 present (runs scripts/clean_vtt.py for the ytdlp backend)
yt-dlp on PATH (the ytdlp backend; brew install yt-dlp)

smoke_test.command: node yt.mjs fetch dQw4w9WgXcQ --explain >/dev/null && node yt.mjs ytdlp dQw4w9WgXcQ --explain >/dev/null && node --test test/*.test.mjs
smoke_test.expect: both pre-flights render without a network call; unit tests green (the clean_vtt.py test skips if python3 is absent). Needs no node_modules and no yt-dlp
